description: This is a C# source code file implementing the CachedVersionSelectorManager class, which manages cached version selection for grains within the Orleans.Runtime.Versions namespace. It contains methods for retrieving suitable silos based on grain types and versions, as well as cache management functions.

classes.name: CachedVersionSelectorManager
classes.description: Manages cached version selection for grain interfaces, facilitating efficient retrieval of suitable silos based on grain type, interface, and version. It includes cache management and version resolution logic.

classes.name: CachedVersionSelectorManager.CachedEntry
classes.description: Represents a cache entry holding the determined version, list of suitable silos, and silos grouped by version.

methods.name: CachedVersionSelectorManager
methods.description: Constructor initializing the cache and dependencies for the manager.

methods.name: GetSuitableSilos
methods.description: Retrieves suitable silos for a given grain type, interface, and requested version, utilizing cache or computing if necessary.

methods.name: ResetCache
methods.description: Clears the internal cache of suitable silos.

methods.name: GetSuitableSilosImpl
methods.description: Internal implementation for computing the suitable silos based on grain interface versions, selectors, and compatibility.
